themes.name: Push notifications
themes.description: Reviews about push or news alert notifications, including the missing option to turn them off, notifications that are not dismissed after tapping, and the volume or relevance of alerts.

themes.name: Playlist and queue behavior
themes.description: Reviews about the playlist or queue: playlists being cleared or lost, stories skipping, starting midway or being cut off, and the ability to add, reorder or remove items.

themes.name: Live stream connectivity
themes.description: Reviews about connecting to and playing live radio streams and local stations, including endless buffering, 'can't play media' errors, dropped streams, and handoff between WiFi and mobile data.

themes.name: App crashes and freezes
themes.description: Reviews about the app crashing, force closing, freezing, hanging, or glitching the phone, including lock screen problems and failures after updates or on specific devices.

themes.name: Battery and background activity
themes.description: Reviews about battery drain, the app running or restarting in the background on its own, the lack of an exit or close button, and audio that resumes after pausing or closing.

themes.name: Advertising and sponsorship
themes.description: Reviews about banner ads, full-screen or pop-up ads, ads that cannot be closed, and sponsorship messages in audio.

themes.name: Interface design
themes.description: Reviews about visual design, layout, navigation and how modern or dated the UI looks, including Material Design, font size, and overall ease of use.

themes.name: Tablet and rotation support
themes.description: Reviews about screen orientation, landscape mode, auto-rotate, and tablet support.

themes.name: Station and program availability
themes.description: Reviews about which stations, local stations, programs, podcasts and episodes are available or missing, and whether content lists update.

themes.name: Article display and media
themes.description: Reviews about how news articles render in the app, including missing images, videos or tweets, scrambled or overlapping text, and audio missing from stories.

themes.name: Offline and download features
themes.description: Reviews requesting or discussing downloading audio, offline listening, caching, and storing the app on an SD card.

themes.name: Privacy and permissions
themes.description: Reviews about the app's access to location, contacts, phone info, and other permissions or data collection.

themes.name: Political bias
themes.description: Reviews about perceived political slant, fairness, trustworthiness and journalistic quality of NPR's news content.

themes.name: Casting and widget features
themes.description: Reviews about Chromecast or casting support and the home screen widget.
